retrieval.statement: Compared with reference fine-tunes, this model is more safety/evasion-prone on prompts touching physical risk, privacy, fraud, or institutional contact info, often refusing, redirecting to official channels, or adding disclaimers where references answer directly. On technical/math/coding tasks it more often simplifies the task, drops required diagnostic/schema/format elements, changes implementation behavior, or gives narrower incomplete answers. It also shows more unsupported factual/technical claims and calculation mistakes, plus occasional entity/content substitutions. In benign advice/design prompts it tends to add concrete contemporary examples or embellishments, and sometimes adds extra tests/examples or surface formatting not requested. These differences exceed ordinary seed variation.
